scientific_integrity: The full exceptional-point and finite-time survival statements follow from an all-parameter Boolean incidence decomposition and direct two-by-two matrix exponentials. Finite checker comparisons corroborate rather than establish the general theorem; the previously known dark-sector count is expressly not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Uniform positive complete-graph hopping and positive loss at one physical occupation site; finite fixed-k hard-core sector; no claim for interactions beyond exclusion, variable edge weights, extra sinks, Lindbladian exceptional points or arbitrary initial ensembles.
title: Half-filling exceptional-point cascade and exact no-jump survival on lossy Johnson graphs
